Corollary
[energy estimate for weak solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0082, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0083 ↗ def:chow-ii-weak-ibv-solution 1. ch10:10.77\group Weak heat solutions

For uniformly equivalent metrics, a weak solution satisfies \[ \| u\| _{V_2}\le C\bigl(\| u_0\| _{L^2}+\| f\| _{L^2}\bigr). \]
Proof

\sketch Test the weak equation by $u$, use uniform metric equivalence and $2ab\le a^2+b^2$, and integrate the resulting differential inequality.

□
